# Scenario: failed apply after proxy compose change keeps the old proxy; next cycle
# retries without a new Git commit once the host dependency is fixed (proxy REL-01).
#
# Cycle 1: deploy e2e-ppend on inbound :9973 → apinfra-proxy up; curl OK.
# Cycle 2: Git inbound.port → :9974 + bad registry → login fails;
#          infra/.apply_pending stays; same proxy cid; :9973 still serves, :9974 dead.
# Cycle 3: fix .apinfra only (no Git) → proxy pull/up; pending cleared; curl :9974.
# Cycle 4: unchanged → still on :9974.

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: proxy apply pending baseline'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

exec apinfra
stderr 'done duration='
docker-assert-running apinfra-proxy
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-ppend-web
! exists $HOME/infra/.apply_pending
exec curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:9973/
stdout 'PPEND_OK'

exec sh -c 'docker ps -aq --filter name=apinfra-proxy > $WORK/old-proxy-cid'
exec sh -c 'test -s $WORK/old-proxy-cid'

cd git-repo
cp ../settings.port-b.yml dev/settings.yml
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'chore: inbound port change for proxy pending retry'
cd ..

# Bad registry so login fails after the proxy compose change is staged.
cp .apinfra.bad-registry .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

exec apinfra
stderr 'logging into registry 127.0.0.1:1'
stderr 'docker login 127.0.0.1:1'
stderr 'plan proxy=compose_changed'
stderr 'WARN cycle finished with errors'
stderr 'done duration='

exists $HOME/infra/.apply_pending
docker-assert-running apinfra-proxy
exec sh -c 'test "$(docker ps -aq --filter name=apinfra-proxy)" = "$(cat $WORK/old-proxy-cid)"'
exec curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:9973/
stdout 'PPEND_OK'
! exec curl -sf --connect-timeout 2 http://127.0.0.1:9974/

# Recover host dependency without another Git commit.
cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

exec apinfra
stderr 'plan proxy=apply_pending'
stderr 'done duration='
docker-assert-running apinfra-proxy
exec sh -c 'test "$(docker ps -aq --filter name=apinfra-proxy)" != "$(cat $WORK/old-proxy-cid)"'
! exists $HOME/infra/.apply_pending
exec curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:9974/
stdout 'PPEND_OK'
! exec curl -sf --connect-timeout 2 http://127.0.0.1:9973/

exec apinfra
stderr 'plan proxy=skip'
stderr 'done duration='
docker-assert-running apinfra-proxy
! exists $HOME/infra/.apply_pending
exec curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:9974/
stdout 'PPEND_OK'

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- .apinfra.bad-registry --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main
containerRegistryHost=127.0.0.1:1
containerRegistryUser=bad
containerRegistryToken=bad
dockerLoginTimeout=5s

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-ppend
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9973
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- settings.port-b.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-ppend
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9974
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-ppend/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=PPEND_OK"]
-- .env --
